sn45.4:1.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇha samayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
sn45.4:1.3: addasā kho āyasmā ānando jāṇussoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sabbasetena vaḷavābhirathena sāvatthiyā niyyāyantaṃ
sn45.4:1.4: setā sudaṃ assā yuttā honti setālaṅkārā seto ratho setaparivāro setā rasmiyo setā patodalaṭṭhi setaṃ chattaṃ setaṃ uṇhīsaṃ setāni vatthāni setā upāhanā setāya sudaṃ vālavījaniyā vījiyyati.
sn45.4:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn45.4:3.1: idhāhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ
sn45.4:3.2: addasaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante jāṇussoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sabbasetena vaḷavābhirathena sāvatthiyā niyyāyantaṃ
sn45.4:3.3: setā sudaṃ assā yuttā setālaṅkārā seto ratho setaparivāro setā rasmiyo setā patodalaṭṭhi setaṃ chattaṃ setaṃ uṇhīsaṃ setāni vatthāni setā upāhanā setāya sudaṃ vālavījaniyā vījiyyati.
sn45.4:3.7: sakkā nu kho bhante imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmayānaṃ paññapetunti.
sn45.4:4.2: imasseva kho etaṃ ānanda ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ
sn45.4:4.3: brahmayānaṃ itipi dhammayānaṃ itipi anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo itipi.

sn45.4:5.2: sammāsaṅkappo ānanda bhāvito bahulīkato rāgavinayapariyosāno hoti dosavinayapariyosāno hoti mohavinayapariyosāno hoti.

sn45.4:5.4: sammākammanto ānanda bhāvito bahulīkato rāgavinayapariyosāno hoti dosavinayapariyosāno hoti mohavinayapariyosāno hoti.
sn45.4:5.5: sammāājīvo ānanda bhāvito bahulīkato rāgavinayapariyosāno hoti dosavinayapariyosāno hoti mohavinayapariyosāno hoti.
sn45.4:5.6: sammāvāyāmo ānanda bhāvito bahulīkato rāgavinayapariyosāno hoti dosavinayapariyosāno hoti mohavinayapariyosāno hoti.
sn45.4:5.7: sammāsati ānanda bhāvitā bahulīkatā rāgavinayapariyosānā hoti dosavinayapariyosānā hoti mohavinayapariyosānā hoti.
sn45.4:5.8: sammāsamādhi ānanda bhāvito bahulīkato rāgavinayapariyosāno hoti dosavinayapariyosāno hoti mohavinayapariyosāno hoti.
sn45.4:6.1: iminā kho etaṃ ānanda pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā imassevetaṃ ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ
sn45.4:6.2: brahmayānaṃ itipi dhammayānaṃ itipi anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo itipīti.
